notes.title: Update on Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/4874e47ede688f4b5ffd324a4569b9b59d9f53bf.png[/img]
EDIT: Steam Trading Cards are now available. We’re also adding an in game option to quickly exit out of the game on 25th May 2017. Thanks for playing Dragon Quest Heroes II! 

=====

Dragon Quest Heroes II has just been released on Steam and we hope you’re all enjoying the game so far!
You may have noticed that Steam Trading Cards are missing from the game but don’t worry, we will be adding them to the game as soon as possible. 

On a side note, when playing in full screen mode, if you want to quit the game quickly, the easiest way to do this is to press Alt-Tab and close the program if you have a keyboard ready. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/7f5417b02b2231323dcecceb18bc112e65849ab5.jpg[/img]

If you wish to enjoy the authentic Dragon Quest feeling then speak to the Chapel tender and end your adventure (you can also save your game here). A bit later into the game, you’ll have to cast the Zoom or Evac spell to return to Accordia to get to the Chapel too.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/09d472438b213bd34a8795dc944bb460cc347f29.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now but let us know if you run into any problems and we hope you enjoy Dragon Quest Heroes II!
